messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences that state this fact in your own words, without copying its phrasing (use the two names exactly): Zolu Industries participated in Nolu Accord Talks

response: Zolu Industries sent a delegation to the Nolu Accord Talks and took an active seat at the table. Its representatives joined the working groups on the second day.
